sites.name: Da Qaidam, northern Qaidam Basin margin (Qinghai)
sites.note: Qaidam is a well-known Mars analog region (Dalangtan playa); new here is only its match to Connecting Ridge terrain, a lunar use that the literature query rarely finds. Its literature count is above the threshold, so it is a known site, not a low-attention one. The terrain cell stays in the robust set with a second DEM (NASADEM) and also matches de Gerlache rim and the peak near Shackleton (exploratory; validation report 7c).

sites.name: Peary Land, North Greenland
sites.note: DESIGN 2.5 #6 proposed Peary Land for L2 (low Sun); the engine does NOT confirm L2 there (sun geometry is NO-ANALOG everywhere). It confirms L1 instead, through a rank cell found by the coarse screen (not the seed), 20 km from the X1 seed, and X1, which is only engine-semiquant (condition floors set after seeing data, calibrated on Beacon Valley; the X1 seed list was committed together with the first X1 scores, so it is not provably pre-registered). The L1 cell carries an ice flag (0.15). Unique only within the scored sample (X1 has 8 cell-level TRANSFERS, M1 none). MARGINAL: recomputed from a second DEM (ArcticDEM) the L1 cell leaves the robust set (native rank 19 of 49 in the full-metric configuration, 26 with Copernicus GLO-30; the rule needs 24.5), so the terrain verdict here depends on the DEM (validation report 7c).
